118594.name: Chabad Russian Center of S. Florida
118594.note: Miami Herald (via CrownHeights.info, 17 Dec 2007): Rabbi Alexander Kaller 'came into town in 2002'; the synagogue 'humbly started off in 2002' in the rabbi's living room, moved after a few months to the meeting room at the Oceania condos, then to a 65-seat storefront synagogue in a strip mall; its waterfront center opened in 2026.

earlier.where: the meeting room at the Oceania condos
a storefront synagogue in a strip mall, Sunny Isles Beach

118653.name: Chabad at the Beaches
118653.note: A staff bio on its site: moved to Ponte Vedra 'in December of 2003 to open Chabad at the Beaches'; CrownHeights.info, 12 June 2014: it 'celebrated 11 years' (Rabbi Nochum and Leah Kurinsky). Named for Aaron and Blanche Scharf.

118646.name: Chabad of Naples
118646.note: Jewish Federation of Greater Naples' Connections 2022: established by Rabbi Fishel and Ettie Zaklos in 2004 (also 'Since 2004' on a kosher directory). 1789 Mandarin Road. therebbesimpact.com: 2003.

118534.name: Chabad @ University of Miami
118534.note: Wikipedia: 'In 1973, Eliezrie established the Chabad House at the University of Miami' (Rabbi David Eliezrie, who went on to Orange County); a Miami Herald report of 14 June 1974 announced a Chabad House 'rap center' (cited in Korf's 2025 obituary). Today Rabbi Mendy and Henchi Fellig direct it (1251 Hardee Rd., by 2011); when they took over, and whether it ran without a break, is not established.

118656.name: Chabad at Midtown Miami
118656.note: Its charity listing gives 2004 as the year it was established (Rabbi Shmuel Gopin, 221 NE 29th St.). therebbesimpact.com: the center and the Gopins 2003. Only a directory: to check.

118658.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Jupiter
118658.note: TCPalm (via CrownHeights.info, April 2006): the 'three-year-old congregation' of founder Rabbi Berel Barash closed on 1.5 acres on University Boulevard in Abacoa for $1 million; its two-story center at 430 University Blvd. was due late 2018.
